limits: Exact directEnemy source snakeDesertA, CEL enSnakeDesertA(Clone), motion renderer enDesertSnakeA and source renderer 121552 only. This archive grants no inheritance to snakeJungleC, snakeBasey, another snake source or another renderer topology.

The ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer without a skill cap or damage fixture and produced native Damaged for 10 HP, from 58 to 48. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced HP from 48 to 0 with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll true with 13 active rigidbodies. They remain kinematic through frame 27; at frame 28 the animator disables and all 13 bodies become dynamic. Measured motion begins at frame 29 and all measured linear and angular velocity is zero from frame 50 through frame 119.

All three captures retain the requested 120 frames. The exact renderer remains active, enabled, reported visible and identity-stable through every retained frame. The sampled grounded pose persists into the loot sequence, but the later panel occludes most of the target and does not establish exact collision, general corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.
One guarded native Collect action succeeded and strict Ready succeeded at level 0, room 2, with one button.

Seventeen selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground hero overlap, motion blur and the loot panel limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 343 capture PNGs were preserved by hash but not individually reviewed.

The profile preserves the native CEL scale of 0.65 at public visualScale 1.0, the PortraitCam marker and an unlit inherited emission state. This route does not establish portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions or all-angle culling.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every snake animation, collision, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another snake source, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
